newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Apple South downgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Apple South downgraded.

text.p: -- Interstate/Johnson Lane analyst Stephanie Haggerty said in a research note that she lowered her recommendation on Apple South Inc to neutral from buy.
-- Shares were up 5/8 to 13-5/8 in morning Nasdaq trade.

-- The neutral rating will remain "until visibility improves" the analyst said, referring to several successive negative announcement from the company in recent months, the most recent being Wednesday's warning of weak near-term earnings.
